data.title: Strategy: campaign plan for BuzzBrew
data.output:
DATA FLAG: the research handoff attached is a cosmetics/fragrance catalog (mascara, eyeshadow, Chanel, Dior, Gucci) — it has nothing to do with BuzzBrew, a cold-brew coffee subscription club. I'm not building a channel plan around lipstick SKUs. The one thing I'm carrying forward from that miss is the price-tier logic (a sub-$20 entry tier and a $50-130 premium tier), which I'm translating into subscription tiers below. Everything else in this plan is built from BuzzBrew's actual category: DTC cold-brew coffee subscription, competing for the same attention as Blue Bottle, Trade Coffee, and Cometeer.

POSITIONING
BuzzBrew = smooth, no-crash cold brew delivered on your schedule, for people who treat their morning coffee as a ritual, not a chore. Target: urban/suburban professionals and remote workers, 24-40, disposable income, already spend $5-7/day at coffee shops, sustainability- and quality-conscious.

SUBSCRIPTION TIERS (from the price-band signal)
- Trial Bag — $18/first month, 4x12oz concentrate bottles, kills signup friction
- Core Club (hero SKU) — $34/month, 8 bottles + free reusable glass carafe on month 1
- Reserve Drop — $65/month, limited single-origin small-batch, quarterly, built for gifting and superfans

CHANNEL-BY-CHANNEL PLAN

1. TikTok (primary growth engine, ~30% of budget)
Objective: top-of-funnel awareness via trend-jacking and founder authenticity.
Content pillars: brewing-process ASMR, "rating gas station cold brew vs BuzzBrew" bits, day-in-the-life fueled-by-BuzzBrew, employee/founder POV.
Cadence: 5x/week, all native vertical video, no paid boosts week 1 (organic seeding first).
KPI: watch-through rate >50%, 15k+ profile visits/week by week 3.

2. Instagram (brand-building + conversion bridge, ~25%)
Reels mirror TikTok winners within 48 hrs; Feed carries product photography and subscriber UGC; Stories run daily polls/behind-the-scenes and a permanent "Subscribe" link sticker.
Cadence: 4 Reels/week, 3 Feed posts/week, daily Stories.
KPI: saves/shares ratio, link-in-bio CTR >2%.

3. Meta Ads — Instagram + Facebook paid (~25%)
Phase 1 (Weeks 1-2): prospecting via lookalike audiences off existing customer list + interest stacks (coffee subscription, home brewing, WFH lifestyle). Creative: UGC-style video with "first bag $18" offer.
Phase 2 (Weeks 3-4): retargeting site visitors and cart-abandoners with a carafe-bundle upsell.
KPI: target CAC under $22, ROAS >2.5x by week 4.

4. Email/SMS via Klaviyo (retention engine, ~10%)
Welcome series (3 emails: brew story, how-to-serve guide, referral offer), monthly "what's brewing" newsletter tied to Reserve Drop releases, SMS for shipping alerts + flash 48-hr reorder discounts.
KPI: welcome series conversion >12%, list growth 500+/month via on-pack QR codes.

5. Micro-influencer/UGC seeding (~7%)
20-30 micro-influencers (15k-80k followers) in coffee, wellness, and remote-work-lifestyle niches. Gifted trial bag + 20% affiliate code, no upfront fees. Prioritize creators who already film "morning routine" content — lowest-friction placement.
KPI: 15+ organic posts/month, blended affiliate CAC under paid CAC.

6. Owned community + local activation (~3%)
Subscriber Discord/community for early access to Reserve Drops; pop-up sampling at 2-3 farmers markets or coworking spaces per month with QR-code signup for a free trial bag.
KPI: community-to-paid conversion, local zip-code signup lift.

CAMPAIGN TIMELINE (4-week launch sprint)
Week 1 — Teaser: organic TikTok/IG only, no paid spend, seed influencers, build waitlist.
Week 2 — Launch: turn on Meta prospecting ads, push welcome-offer ($18 trial) sitewide, first influencer posts go live.
Week 3 — Momentum: retarget site traffic, publish UGC compilation Reels, launch referral program via email.
Week 4 — Retention: promote Core Club upgrade path, tease first Reserve Drop, review CAC/ROAS and reallocate budget toward the top 2 performing channels.

SUCCESS METRICS (roll-up)
Primary: trial-to-Core-Club upgrade rate >25% by day 30; blended CAC under $25; Month-1 subscriber retention >80%.
Secondary: TikTok follower growth, email list growth, influencer-driven revenue share.

ANYTHING_UNCLEAR
- Actual BuzzBrew price points, shipping footprint (national vs regional), and existing customer/email list size were not provided — tier pricing and CAC/ROAS targets above are informed estimates for a DTC cold-brew subscription and should be recalibrated against real unit economics before ad spend is finalized.
